result:
All four materials ran with the protocol; none hit STOP. The checks passed for glulam and CLT and failed for soft wood fibre board and aluminium extrusion. The machine values for the two built materials are fallback figures, not three-machine medians.

GWP-fossil A1–A3 per kg, against the median of the EN 15804+A2 EPDs in OBD_2024_III (the newest ÖKOBAUDAT data stock the API lists):

| Material | LCI kept | Ours | EPD median (n) | Ratio | Result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| glulam | exact match (D1) | 0.340 | 0.291 (7) | 1.17 | CHECK 1 pass |
| CLT | exact match (D1) | 0.349 | 0.242 (4) | 1.44 | CHECK 1 pass, near the +50 % edge |
| soft wood fibre board | built from scratch, flagged | 0.919 | 0.540 (4) | 1.70 | CHECK 2 and 3 fail, REVIEW |
| aluminium extrusion | built from scratch, flagged | 13.0 | 4.17 (10) | 3.11 | CHECK 3 fails, REVIEW |

- **Glulam and CLT:** both use the ecoinvent market dataset (Europe without Switzerland for glulam, RER for CLT).
- **Soft wood fibre board:**
  - Every ecoinvent candidate has extra binders, so D1 is no; D1b picks `market for fibreboard, soft` (RER).
  - The built LCI is 1.701× the median and the approximate match is 1.704×, so it is effectively a tie. The REVIEW rule keeps the built one.
- **Aluminium extrusion:** ecoinvent only has the extrusion process, not the profile, so D1 and D1b are no. The alloy market alone is 12.84 kg CO₂e/kg, so energy rows are about 1 % of the result. The EPD median is pulled down by low-carbon and recycled profiles.

- **Machine values (P1/P2):** datasheets almost never give power, throughput and mass together, so I used the protocol's fallbacks (EU BREF wood-based panels, aluminium-guide.com, the US DOE aluminium bandwidth study, vendor kW over a 6 t/h line). All of these rows are marked proxy, TeR 4. Wear rows exist only for the fibre board refiner and dryer (0.033 % of GWP-fossil); the aluminium wear share is "not computed".
- **Assumptions to confirm:**
  - Machine life is assumed at 20 years (the protocol gives no default for years).
  - Piece weights for I1/X1 use assumed formats with sourced densities.
  - ES/IT/NL manufacturer searches for A4 · T2 were not exhaustive; all four materials still reached 3 of 5 countries with sourced links (all national, 150 km).
- **Unit convention:** wood-board amounts are in m³ (1 kg ÷ the dataset's wet mass), because the datasets are in m³.
- **Median choices:** which EPDs count as "in the category" changes the medians, especially for aluminium profiles; the exclusions are logged in `epd_check.csv` and `protocol_issues.md`. I excluded three EMERUS entries with implausible values, coated/anodised profiles, and façade systems.
- **Brightway and workbook:** the Brightway project and the workbook were only read, never changed. Scripts are in `work/`.

Everything is in `runs/batch_7/`; open `summary.md` first and `protocol_issues.md` second:
